messages.description: Discovers local Docker contexts (including Docker Desktop and OrbStack), Podman, and Docker in Windows WSL distributions. Build and connection use the selected environment; your default Docker context is unchanged.
No container engine found. Install or start Docker, OrbStack, or Podman, then refresh.
This folder has no configuration. Create one using the options below.
A configuration already exists or changed. Reload the folder before continuing.
Use an existing image, or build the Dockerfile in your workspace. The official Dev Container CLI handles building and startup.
Image name and optional tag or digest. The engine may download the image when you build.
Path relative to the selected workspace folder. The file must stay inside the workspace.
Folder relative to the workspace, made available to Dockerfile COPY commands. Empty uses the workspace root.
User or UID to connect as inside the container. Empty uses the image default.
Absolute folder to open inside the container. Empty uses the folder resolved by the Dev Container CLI. This option does not add a mount.
TCP ports from 1 to 65535, separated by commas. Published on the same loopback port of the selected environment; WSL ports are published inside that distribution.
Optional command run inside the new container by the official CLI. It runs only after you trust and build the workspace.
Invalid value for {field}. Check the field’s information and try again.

en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.runtimeHelp: Discovers local Docker contexts (including Docker Desktop and OrbStack), Podman, and Docker in Windows WSL distributions. Build and connection use the selected environment; your default Docker context is unchanged.
en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.noRuntime: No container engine found. Install or start Docker, OrbStack, or Podman, then refresh.
en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.createMissin: This folder has no configuration. Create one using the options below.
en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.configConfli: A configuration already exists or changed. Reload the folder before continuing.
en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.name: Name
en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.sourceH: Use an existing image, or build the Dockerfile in your workspace. The official Dev Container CLI handles building and startup.
en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.imageHe: Image name and optional tag or digest. The engine may download the image when you build.
en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.dockerf: Path relative to the selected workspace folder. The file must stay inside the workspace.
en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.buildCo: Folder relative to the workspace, made available to Dockerfile COPY commands. Empty uses the workspace root.
en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.remoteU: User or UID to connect as inside the container. Empty uses the image default.
en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.workspa: Absolute folder to open inside the container. Empty uses the folder resolved by the Dev Container CLI. This option does not add a mount.
en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.portsHe: TCP ports from 1 to 65535, separated by commas. Published on the same loopback port of the selected environment; WSL ports are published inside that distribution.
en-US.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.postCre: Optional command run inside the new container by the official CLI. It runs only after you trust and build the workspace.

zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.runtimeHelp: 自动识别本机 Docker context（含 Docker Desktop、OrbStack）、Podman，以及 Windows WSL 各发行版中的 Docker。构建和连接始终使用所选环境，不更改默认 Docker context。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.noRuntime: 未找到容器引擎。安装或启动 Docker、OrbStack 或 Podman 后刷新。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.createMissin: 此文件夹还没有配置，可填写以下选项创建。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.configConfli: 配置已存在或发生变化，请重新读取文件夹后继续。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.name: 名称
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.nameHel: 可选的配置名称，将写入 devcontainer.json。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.sourceH: 可直接使用镜像，或构建工作区中的 Dockerfile。构建和启动交给官方 Dev Container CLI。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.imageHe: 填写镜像名及可选的标签或摘要。构建时容器引擎可能下载镜像。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.dockerf: 相对于所选工作区文件夹的路径，文件必须位于工作区内。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.buildCo: 相对于工作区的文件夹，Dockerfile 的 COPY 命令可读取其中的文件。留空使用工作区根目录。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.remoteU: 进入容器时使用的用户名或 UID。留空使用镜像的默认用户。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.workspa: 容器内要打开的绝对路径。留空使用 Dev Container CLI 确定的目录，此选项不会新增挂载。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.portsHe: 填写 1 到 65535 的 TCP 端口，以逗号分隔。将映射到所选环境的本机回环地址同号端口；WSL 环境中映射到该发行版。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.form.postCre: 可选命令，由官方 CLI 在容器创建后执行。仅在信任并构建工作区后运行。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.devcontainer.invalidField: {field}填写有误，请查看该项说明后修改。
